# Claude Code (Anthropic)

Claude Code names both a harness and the agent built on it, by context, so each sense is its own link:

- **The harness:** an [agent harness][industry.agent-harness], which Anthropic calls an [agentic harness][anthropic.agentic-harness] ([Claude Code glossary][a3]).
- **The agent:** an [agent][industry.agent], which Anthropic calls an [agentic coding tool][anthropic.agentic-coding-tool] ([overview][a2]).
